Frequently asked questions

How much are custom dry-fit shirts?

Custom dry-fit shirts start at $15. Final pricing depends on the style, quantity and decoration. Message us for a quote.

Can I see a mockup before I order?

Yes. We design up to 3 front-and-back mockups with your logo so you can compare options before anything is made.

Do you offer bulk pricing?

Yes, for larger orders, multiple crews and repeat orders. Send your approximate count and preferred style.

What colors do the safety vests come in?

Our hi-vis safety vest with pockets comes in Safety Green, Safety Orange and Black. We also carry ANSI Class 2 and Class 3 Viz-Dri safety shirts.

Do you make banners?

Yes. We make custom full-color vinyl banners with your logo, like our 4' x 8' banner, for shops, sales, grand openings and events.

How do I get started?

Use the quote form, call or text (657) 789-3046, or email workfitus@gmail.com.
